tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Rice paper in light, lacquer black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the assistant panel, the input field, grouped list rows. Sits on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The user's message bubble, code blocks, the address field, pressed states. Sits on ground or surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface and surface-raised. Also the fill of seal chips and settings icon tiles.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, captions, values. On ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, chevrons, tertiary labels. On ground and surface only; too weak on surface-raised.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Separators between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: input field, suggestion chips, the off switch. 3:1 on ground and surface.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The Agent and the primary action: primary button fill, send button, on switch, the ring, progress. Text on it is on-gold.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill. Always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold used as text or icon on ground, surface or gold-wash: text buttons, links, Agent tool names, the running state.

tokens.name: gold-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted background for Agent things: the model pill, the 'saved' note, count badges. Text on it is gold-ink or ink.

tokens.name: jade
tokens.usage: Content that came from a website: result card labels, citation numbers, source links. Text or icon on ground, surface or jade-wash.

tokens.name: jade-wash
tokens.usage: Background of citation chips and result card headers. Text on it is jade or ink.

tokens.name: cinnabar
tokens.usage: Stop, destructive actions and errors inside the app; the seal colour in brand moments (cover, icon). Never for 'new' or 'unread'.

tokens.name: on-cinnabar
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cinnabar fill.

tokens.name: cinnabar-wash
tokens.usage: Background of error messages. Text on it is cinnabar or ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Alias of cinnabar for error text and icons, so code can say what it means.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done and passed states, always with a check icon and a word. Text or icon on ground and surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-attention states, always with an icon and a word. Text or icon on ground and surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind sheets and popovers.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles: Home, Settings. iOS .largeTitle, bold.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet and section titles. iOS .title2, bold.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Panel title, row titles that need weight, button labels. iOS .headline.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text and list rows. iOS .body.
styles.sample: Signature images are hidden on every topic here.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Conversation text, suggestion chips, card bodies. iOS .subheadline.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Row subtitles, helper text under fields. iOS .footnote.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status line, seal chips, badges. iOS .caption, semibold.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Tool names, match rules, code blocks, token counts. iOS .footnote, monospaced.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip or pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, between a field and its button, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside cards and rows; between conversation items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen's first section; large empty-state gaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Seal chips, citation chips, badges, settings icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, the input field, suggestion chips, the address field, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped list sections, popovers, the browser bar.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the assistant panel and other sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only the ring: the round Agent, mic, send and stop buttons, and switches. Nothing else is a capsule.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The assistant panel rising over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the floating browser bar.

tokens.name: hairline-width
tokens.usage: Separators and card edges, with hairline; control edges, with border-strong.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: The gold ring: focus, the running state, the idle mic and Agent buttons.
